x: A sword assembled from a blade head and a handle. The blade decides its tier, metal, damage and most of its durability; the handle decides the grip and adds durability of its own. The two are independent, so any handle fits any blade. A finished sword can be re-wrapped, or given a stone, without taking it apart - put it in the grid with the wrap or nugget - and a hammer above a sword takes it apart, handing the handle back and leaving the blade head with its quench and its wear.
